tracks.title: Static and Pixels
tracks.loreNote: Featured during the opening portal sequence of *Runebreaker*, when a blinding surge of purple static erupts from the living room CRT television on October 30, 1992, pulling eighteen-year-old fraternal twins Ocea and Tay into the fractured digital-fantasy realm of the Dream Kingdom.

tracks.title: Half a Medallion
tracks.loreNote: A groovy, 16-bit psychedelic funk-rock anthem that plays in the Crystal Sage's laboratory when Ocea's fire-engine red half of her summer-camp clay medallion resonates with the ancient Runebreaker gauntlet, teaching her how to picture the whole medallion in her mind and channel golden pixel magic.
